Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of the synthesized nanotubular supports are shown in Fig. 3A. In the case of the TNT(x) materials with high sodium content (7.1, 5.4, and 3.2 wt.% Na), four main diffraction peaks can be observed at 10.5°, 24.3°, 28.4°, and 48.1° (2θ), which are typical of monoclinic layered sodium trititanate (JCPDS card 31-1329) and correspond to its (0 0 1), (2 0 1), (1 1 1), and (0 2 0) crystal planes, respectively.
